additional_public_contracts.contract: Stable v1 POST create, GET get/resume, DELETE, POST cancel. Preserve explicit beta calls. Unary and SSE model and agent requests, storage and manual/automatic continuation.

Previous interaction ID retains conversation history. Long-decode continuation is independent and uses a server-issued continuation token, optional stream checkpoints, and surfaced incomplete progress.
Environment files support root/list/stat, recursive directory archives, binary alt=media, direct and resumable uploads, and optional archive extraction.
Agent credentials are write-only secrets. Verify secret redaction and egress attachment independently of endpoint availability.
v1beta tool_search supports server-side and client-side retrieval, deferred function and MCP declarations, result and SSE variants.
v1beta Voices is separate from Live and GenerateContent. Verify prompted voice creation and the current model, storage, project and replication restrictions.
OAuth bearer Interactions routes omit publishers/google. Include Vertex-only list pagination. Preserve dedicated us/eu hosts for data residency. Verify model and managed-agent support separately.
Managed Antigravity interactions use global v1beta1. Google Cloud preview tool and regional restrictions differ from the Gemini Developer API.

Paid v1beta POST create has model genie-4 with no ordinary input. Short-lived per-interaction auth token create/delete at /v1beta/interactions/{id}/auth_tokens[/{token}]. Dedicated WebSocket /v1beta/interactions/live or WebRTC POST /v1beta/interactions/{id}:webrtc. Explicitly complete to stop generation and billing.
